scope: Visible-online friend notification producer wired to aggregate WebSocket presence callbacks.
behavior: Requires persisted non-offline actor status and Hub visible-presence membership; honors actor privacy.shareOnlineUpdates (default true) and recipient notifications.onlineFriendNotifications (default false).
Uses accepted friendships and bidirectional block checks; writes a scope-free system notification before broadcasting it, naming the actor rather than the recipient.

Callback emits only after a fresh visible first-connect and successful status write; debounced offline observation resets the process-local deduplication epoch only after a successful current-generation status write. Reconnects inside the debounce window are suppressed.
Manual status changes invoke the notifier only after the preference write and visibility update; automatic status changes are gated by the persisted online preference and hidden-presence state.
The process-local per-actor gate retries failed recipients without repeating successful recipients. It is not a durable cross-process exactly-once guarantee.
remaining: Presence callbacks are dispatched asynchronously; ordering under rapid interleaved manual/automatic changes remains unverified.
Two-client live acceptance, including real reconnect behavior, remains open.
release: No external email, publication, or production mutation.
